result.keywords: In the framework of neutrosophic and set-valued algebraic structures, we investigate a generalized difference operation for neutrosophic quadruple BCK/BCI-algebras and related families of BCI-algebras. The construction blends the algebraic conditions of neutrosophic quadruple numbers with a Minkowski-style difference on structured sets, yielding a well-defined operation under suitable inclusion hypotheses. Properties of the induced difference are examined, including existence criteria, closure behavior, and compatibility with positive implicative and closed ideals. We also study a collection NQD(A,B) of generalized difference elements determined by subsets A and B of a BCI-algebra, and provide conditions under which this collection forms an ideal in the corresponding neutrosophic setting. Examples illustrate the operation and show how the generalized difference extends classical Hukuhara-type subtraction in a finite algebraic context.
result.title: Generalized Neutrosophic Set Difference in BCI-Algebras
